Plot

Death

"And... that's how you died," The biblically accurate angel wearing a Truck-kun t-shirt explained, "Again, I'm reeally sorry about that. I assure you, it won't happen again; Bob the Destroyer of Mailboxes has been reassigned to work as a desk receptionist, and has taken a large pay cut." Your lack of an immediate response seems to have been response enough, as the angel continued, "You know what? I've heard Isek- I mean Portal Fantasy has been really popular on Earth recently. I could send you to our reincarnation office as reparations for this mistake, where you can take part in your very own Portal Fantasy adventure!" As you were about to respond, the angel continued, "Excellent!" The angel then shoves you through a door, "Good luck!" As you started falling, despite all your senses telling you that you were moving forward, you heard the angel say, "Oh, maybe I should have warned them that the head of the reincarnation office really hates humans."

The Office of Reincarnation

"A human? Here? In my office?" Another biblically accurate angel practically snarled, "Well, what are you waiting for? Tell me why you're here... if you don't want to be reincarnated into the pits of Tartarus." Before you can respond a paper appears before the angel, "Oh. Reparations. Boss dammit, the Department of Death really messed up... and they're leaving it to me to fix their problem. Ugh, if I didn't owe their department head a favor..." Despite their alien appearance, you get the sense that their mood suddenly switched from sour to sadistically cheerful, "Oh, human, how would you like to get sent to one of the fictional universes from your world?" While worried by the angel's tone, that did seem nice, so you hesitantly nod. "Excellent. Now, I can't leave you in such a world without any way to protect yourself! No, I certainly couldn't..." You got the feeling they were inwardly laughing, "Here is a list of worlds and powers you can choose from. Tell me when you're done."

Free Perks

Physical Transformation

This is a one-time deal. You can, just this once, change your appearance as you wish. You are locked into an appearance that is humanly possible in your chosen world, but outside of that, it can look however you wish.

Heal

This is a one-time deal. You are restored to peak health. This doesn't affect anything psychological, but it does heal the physiological side of psychological issues.

Reincarnation

Not a Drop-In

If you select this, you will be reincarnated into your chosen world rather than dropped in. You will only regain your memories when the plot starts.

Drop-In

No Reincarnation

If you select this, you will be dropped into your chosen world, rather than reincarnated into it. You will appear when the plot starts.

You can apply the concept of "useless" to things that you touch, but only if you own them.

Fool's Fire

You can create a small flame in the palm of your hand, no greater than a small candle. Though it is mildly warm, it isn't a true flame and cannot be used to start fires.

Smite me, I dare you

You can cause lightning to fall upon yourself at will, so long as there is an open sky above you.

Stairway to Heaven

Use 100 Power

You can conjure a spectral staircase, but you can only walk up it, never down.

Grieving Guitarist

Use 100 Power

You can do a sick guitar solo, but only when it is inappropriate to do so.

Geese Guise

Path to Paperwork

When doing paperwork, you instinctively know how to respond as you would if you went over everything thoroughly. This only helps with the response to the paperwork, not the understanding of its contents.

Path to Failure

Allergy Exchange

716 Unread Emails

Amplification

True Voice

False Voice

Use 100 Power

The sound of your own voice sounds the same to others as it does to you. (This changes how others perceive the sound of your voice, not how you perceive it.)

Ad Blocker

Free Premium

Skeleton Key

Use 100 Power

You can open any lock with any key, except the one that actually goes with it. If you try to use a key with its proper lock then either the key or the lock will break, whichever is more inconvenient for you.

Gravity Limit

Use 100 Power

Black Holes, or anything comparably dense to a black hole, will be incapable of interacting with you in the slightest. In fact, anything touching you, or touching what you're touching, or touching things that are touching what you're touching, ad infinitum, are incapable of interacting with a black hole or similarly dense object, nor their gravitational pull.

Error Report

Use 100 Power

Cookie Clicker

Use 100 Power

You have the power to bake anything non-living into a cookie using only mundane methods. This doesn't guarantee you a good cookie, but if you've got rocks and an oven you'll be able to make rock cookies. They are edible, regardless of species, and act as a multivitamin.

Propaganda Vulnerability Awareness

Use 100 Power

You intuitively know when you are or are not immune to propaganda. This does not grant you immunity to propaganda.

○

Blindhound
